rules.name: VENUE_AT_MOST_ONE
rules.description: One venue hosts at most its slot capacity of teams per time slot (capacity comes from the payload, default 1)

rules.name: COACH_NO_OVERLAP
rules.description: One coach coaches at most one team per time slot, EXCEPT in the same venue (D-14: a coach can watch two groups side by side; different venues remain impossible)

rules.name: COACH_PLAYER_NO_OVERLAP
rules.description: A coach-player cannot be in two roles simultaneously

rules.name: TEAM_NO_OVERLAP
rules.description: A team cannot have two sessions at the same time

rules.name: MIN_SESSIONS
rules.description: Each team TARGETS its effective minimum sessions (soft objective bonus, not a hard floor - ENG-18)

rules.name: ONE_SESSION_PER_DAY
rules.description: A team gets at most one session per day (no exception - the allowMultipleSessionsPerDay flag was removed, P4-79)

rules.name: COACH_REST_DAY
rules.description: Each coach keeps at least minRestDays rest day(s) per week (Mon-Fri); HARD by default, PREFERRED relaxes it to a penalized objective term

rules.name: SALARIE_DISTRIBUTION
rules.description: At least one salaried coach (isEmployee) is present each weekday (Mon-Fri); skipped when the club has fewer than two salaried coaches

rules.name: MAX_CONSECUTIVE_SESSIONS
rules.description: No person chains maxConsecutive back-to-back sessions across venues; HARD by default, PREFERRED relaxes it to a penalized objective term

rules.name: AGE_ASCENDING
rules.description: Younger teams train no later than older ones on the same venue and day (exempt when a team has no ageMin or is hard-locked)

rules.name: TRAVEL_FEASIBILITY
rules.description: DISABLED (future extension): travel-time feasibility between venues - engine stub, always satisfied, posts no constraint

rules.name: REQUIRED_BRIDGE
rules.description: DISABLED (future extension): required bridging sessions - engine stub, always satisfied, posts no constraint
